# Climate Adaptation Platform

> A New Zealand-based organization providing resources, case studies, and guidance on climate adaptation strategies for infrastructure and communities.

The Climate Adaptation Platform is headquartered in Timaru, New Zealand, and collaborates with partner organizations including the University of Auckland to advance climate adaptation practices. The platform offers technical guidance, real-world case studies, and policy insights focused on helping communities and infrastructure systems adapt to climate change impacts.

## Key Topics

- Climate Adaptation
- New Zealand
- Infrastructure Resilience
- Sea Level Rise
- Road Asset Management
- Climate Change Adaptation Funding
- UNFCCC
- Coastal Impacts
- Adaptation Partnerships
- Policy & Advocacy
- Case Studies
- Risk Management
- Organizational Vision
- Community Engagement

## Case Studies & Research

- [Case Study Reveals Impacts of Sea Level Rise on Airport Runway](https://climateadaptationplatform.com/case-study-reveals-impacts-of-sea-level-rise-on-airport-runway): Case study on sea-level rise impacts on coastal airport runways
- [Case Study Discusses Climate Change Adaptation Funding](https://climateadaptationplatform.com/case-study-discusses-climate-change-adaptation-funding): Case study on NZ climate change adaptation funding policies
- [Adopting Climate Adaptation in Road Asset Management](https://climateadaptationplatform.com/adopting-climate-adaptation-in-road-asset-management): Technical report on climate adaptation in road asset management
- [Adapting to a Changing Climate - UN Climate Change](https://climateadaptationplatform.com/adapting-to-a-changing-climate-unfccc): Content on climate adaptation aligned with UNFCCC policy
